select mn.P_ID as pId, mn.P_Name as pName, sc.C_Name as pUseUnitName from pre_project mn left join sys_company sc on mn.P_Use_Unit = sc.C_ID ${authSql} and mn.P_ID in
#{item}
and mn.P_Name like CONCAT('%', #{params.proName}, '%')
and sc.C_Name like CONCAT('%', #{params.pUseUnitName}, '%')

select mn.* from SYS_User mn left join SYS_Position_User_P udp on mn.U_ID = udp.U_ID left join SYS_Position_P spp on udp.PP_ID = spp.PP_ID left join SYS_Department_P sdp on sdp.PD_ID = spp.PD_ID where sdp.P_ID = #{pId}
